say:1:1110319001:1.text: That's enough for today. You won this fight.
say:1:1110319001:1.source_cn: 今天就到这里吧。这场战斗，是你们赢了。

say:2:1110319002:1.text: We won...? Alsa and I... beat Brutus the Blood Claw?
say:2:1110319002:1.source_cn: 我们……真的赢了？……我和阿尔萨，赢了战神布鲁特斯？

say:3:1110319003:1.text: I can't believe it! I thought we were done for!
say:3:1110319003:1.source_cn: 真的吗？刚才那下子，还以为我们要完蛋了！

say:4:1110319004:1.text: It's your victory, and it was fun.
say:4:1110319004:1.source_cn: 是你们的胜利。啊，真是场有趣的战斗——

choice_prompt:5:1110319004.text: It's your victory, and it was fun.
choice_prompt:5:1110319004.source_cn: 是你们的胜利。啊，真是场有趣的战斗——

say:6:1110319005:1.text: I remember you, Magister. You're a friend of the Uru Clan.
say:6:1110319005:1.source_cn: 我记得这位魔法师打扮的朋友，你是乌尔氏族的帮手。
say:6:1110319005:1.male: I remember you, Magister. You're a friend of the Uru Clan.
say:6:1110319005:1.female: I remember you, Magister. You're a friend of the Uru Clan.

say:7:1110319006:1.text: You have no issue with this result, right?
say:7:1110319006:1.source_cn: 你对这个结果，没有异议吧？
say:7:1110319006:1.male: You have no issue with this result, right?
say:7:1110319006:1.female: You have no issue with this result, right?

say:8:1110319009:1.text: What are you and <style="stress"><player_name></style> whispering about?
say:8:1110319009:1.source_cn: 布鲁特斯大人居然也会嘀嘀咕咕地说话……<style=s...
say:8:1110319009:1.male: What are you and <style="stress"><player_name></style> whispering about?
say:8:1110319009:1.female: What are you and <style="stress"><player_name></style> whispering about?

say:9:1110319010:1.text: Nothing. Your friend was showing concern. That's all.
say:9:1110319010:1.source_cn: 没什么。你们的朋友表示了关心，仅此而已。

say:10:1110319011:1.text: You may have won, but the trial isn't over yet.
say:10:1110319011:1.source_cn: 这场战斗中你们占了上风，不过试炼还没结束——

say:11:1110319012:1.text: Alsa, Soren, I have a question for you.
say:11:1110319012:1.source_cn: 阿尔萨，索恩，我有个问题问你们。

say:13:1110319014:1.text: Why did you sign up for the Warsong Festival?
say:13:1110319014:1.source_cn: 你们——为什么要参加战歌节？

say:14:1110319015:1.text: Well, to be honest, I've been thinking about this since... since my fight with Soren the other day.
say:14:1110319015:1.source_cn: 参加战歌节的原因吗？实话说，和索恩吵架之后，这几天……...

say:15:1110319016:1.text: I'm here to fulfill our promise to our pops. The Uru Clan can only be recognized if we gain glory and honor at the Warsong Festival.
say:15:1110319016:1.source_cn: 我参加战歌节，是为了实现和老爹的约定。只有在战歌节上获...

say:16:1110319017:1.text: I know how brutal this desert can be. Survival is not guaranteed.
say:16:1110319017:1.source_cn: 我比谁都清楚，这片沙漠是多可怕的地方。这是无法只靠少数...

say:17:1110319018:1.text: I want the Uru Clan to be respected among the other clans. If we lose our chance in this Warsong Festival, we'll have to wait another ten years...
say:17:1110319018:1.source_cn: 我想让乌尔氏族被看到、被尊重。如果错过这个战歌节，就要...

say:18:1110319019:1.text: I understand. Soren, what about you?

say:20:1110319021:1.text: I aim to get stronger, to shield those I hold dear.
say:20:1110319021:1.source_cn: 我想变得更强，保护想保护的人。

say:21:1110319022:1.text: Become stronger, huh? I hope you won't forget what you said today...
say:21:1110319022:1.source_cn: 变强……是吗。原来如此。希望之后的试炼和比赛中，你们不...

say:22:1110319023:1.text: You've cleared this trial. I'll inform Mikola of your triumph. Go to her and inquire about your next challenge. I'll take my leave now.
say:22:1110319023:1.source_cn: 你们通过了这项试炼，我会把结果告知曼卡拉。你们也别忘记...

say:23:1110319024:1.text: Soren, Alsa, I expect to see you at Mars Peak.
say:23:1110319024:1.source_cn: 索恩，阿尔萨，希望能在战神峰上看到你们。

say:24:1110319025:1.text: Yes... I promise we'll meet you there!
say:24:1110319025:1.source_cn: 我也……期待能在战神峰见到您。

say:26:1110319007:1.text: Shhh... Don't be so loud, Magister.
say:26:1110319007:1.source_cn: 小点声，这位魔法师打扮的朋友。
say:26:1110319007:1.male: Shhh... Don't be so loud, Magister.
say:26:1110319007:1.female: Shhh... Don't be so loud, Magister.

say:27:1110319008:1.text: I believe in fair fights, but we need to nurture our young warriors and not put them down like other clans do.
say:27:1110319008:1.source_cn: 我崇尚公平的战斗，但给予年轻人的公平，总是有所不同。
say:27:1110319008:1.male: I believe in fair fights, but we need to nurture our young warriors and not put them down like other clans do.
say:27:1110319008:1.female: I believe in fair fights, but we need to nurture our young warriors and not put them down like other clans do.
